title: Dasharatha proposes a Vedic ritual for progeny
introduction: Dasharatha decides to perform an elaborate Vedic ritual, called Aswamedha yajna, Horse Ritual, to beget children. He being a considerate king in taking conscience of the courtiers, he discusses this aspect with the Vedic scholars and ministers of his court, beforehand.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 8th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य चैवंप्रभावस्य धर्मज्ञस्य महात्मनः |
सुतार्थं तप्यमानस्य नासीद्वंशकरः सुतः
verses.iast:
tasya ca evam prabhāvasya dharmajñasya mahātmanaḥ |
sutārtham tapya mānasya na asīt vaṃśakaraḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: To him, to such an effectual and virtuously great-souled King Dasharatha, , a dynasty-enriching son is not begotten though his heart is burning to beget children.

glosses.meaning: children, to beget, burning, at heart

verses.devanagari:
चिन्तयानस्य तस्यैवं बुद्धिरासीन्महात्मनः |
सुतार्थं वाजिमेधेन किमर्थं न यजाम्यहम्
verses.iast:
cintayānasya tasya evam buddhiḥ āsīn mahātmanaḥ |
sutārtham vājimedhena kim artham na yajāmi aham
verses.translation: To that anguished great-soul, a thought occurred this way, "To beget sons, why should not I perform Horse ritual...[and thus appease the gods in order to beget worthy sons..."]

verses.devanagari:
स निश्चितां मतिं कृत्वा यष्टव्यमिति बुद्धिमान् |
मंत्रिभिः सह धर्मात्मा सर्वैरपि कृतात्मभिः
ततोऽब्रवीदिदं राजा सुमन्त्रं मंत्रिसत्तमम् |
शीघ्रमानय मे सर्वान् गुरूंस्तान्सपुरोहितान्
verses.iast:
sa niścitām matim kṛtvā yaṣṭavyam iti buddhimān |
mantribhiḥ saha dharmātmā sarvaiḥ api kṛta ātmabhiḥ
tato'bravīt mahātejāḥ sumantram mantri sattamam |
śīghram ānaya me sarvān gurūn tān sa purohitān
verses.translation: That intellectual and a conscientious king having resolved with all of his sagacious ministers that such a Vedic ritual is performable, then addressed best ne among ministers, namely Sumantra, "fetch all my teachers and clerics, quickly.."

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुमंत्रः त्वरितं गत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः |
समानयत्स तान्सर्वान्समस्तान्वेदपारगान्
सुयज्ञं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ काश्यपम् |
पुरोहितं वशिष्ठं च ये चाप्यन्ये द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.iast:
tataḥ sumantraḥ tvaritam gatvā tvarita vikramaḥ |
sam ānayat sa tān sarvān samastān veda pāragān
suyajñam vāmadevam ca jābālim atha kāśyapam |
purohitam vaśiśhṭham ca ye ca api anye dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Then Sumantra gone quickly, for he in quickness is a dauntless one, and fetched all of the clerics like Suyajna, Vaama Deva, Jaabala, Kshyapa, and even Sage Vashishta, and also those other eminent Brahman that are Vedic scholars.

verses.devanagari:
तान्पूजयित्वा धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथस्तदा |
इदं धर्मार्थसहितं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tān pUjayitvā dharmātmā rājā daśarathaḥ tadā |
idam dharma artha sahitam ślakṣṇam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Then on adoring them virtuous King Dasharatha spoke this impressible sentence that included justification and meaning.

verses.devanagari:
मम लालप्यमानस्य सुतार्थं नास्ति वै सुखम् |
तदर्थं हयमेधेन यक्ष्यामीति मतिर्मम
verses.iast:
mama lālasya mānasya sutārtham nāsti vai sukham |
tadartham hayamedhena yakśhyāmi iti matir mama
verses.translation: "My mind is tumultuous without quietude for I have no sons... for that reason, I wish perform Aswametha, Vedic Horse Ritual... this is my thinking...

verses.devanagari:
तदहं यष्टुमिच्छमि शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा |
कथं प्राप्स्याम्यहं कामं बुद्धिरत्र विचिन्त्यताम्
verses.iast:
tat aham yaṣṭum icchami śāstra dṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
katham prāpsyāmi aham kāmam buddhiḥ atra vicintyatām
verses.translation: "Therefore, I contemplate to perform that ritual as enshrined in the scriptures and as a rite-oriented one as well... let this contemplation of mine be well thought of... and as to how my desire to beget sons will be fulfilled...

glosses.meaning: scriptures, point of view [as enshrined in]
to perform ritual, I contemplate to
contemplation, for that, be thought of.

verses.devanagari:
ततः साध्विति तद्वाक्यं ब्राह्मणाः प्रत्यपूजयन् |
वशिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्वे पार्थिवस्य मुखेरितम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sādhu iti tadvākyam brāhmaṇāḥ pratyapUjayan |
vaśiśhṭha pramukhāḥ sarve pārthivasya mukheritam
verses.translation: Then the Brahman scholars along with Sage Vashishta and all other important personalities in their turn have blessed and honoured him, saying that "splendid is this idea..." thus, for that which is voiced by the king.

verses.devanagari:
ऊचुश्च परमप्रीताः सर्वे दशरथं वचः |
संभाराः संभ्रियंतां ते तुरगश्च विमुच्यताम्
verses.iast:
ūcuḥ ca parama prītāḥ sarve daśaratham vacaḥ |
sambhārāḥ sambhriyantām te turagaḥ ca vimucyatām
verses.translation: All of them becoming happy have also said to King Dasharatha, "let the paraphernalia be provided, and your ritual-horse be released...

verses.devanagari:
सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम् |
सर्वथा प्राप्स्यसे पुत्रानभिप्रेतांश्च पार्थिव
यस्य ते धर्मिकी बुद्धिरियं पुत्रार्थमागता |
verses.iast:
sarayvāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhūmir vidhīyatām |
sarvathā prāpsyase putrān abhipretān ca pārthiva
yasya te dharmikī buddhiḥ iyam putrārtham āgatā |
verses.translation: "Oh, king, by all means you will beget sons as you desired, since you, to whom an upright thinking has suggested itself... let the ritual ground be arranged on the northern banks of River Sarayu..." So said the scholars.

glosses.meaning: ritual, ground, be arranged yasya te = to whom, like you
to beget sons, suggested itself to.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तुष्टोऽभवद्राजा श्रुत्वैतद् द्विजभाषितम्
अमात्यांश्चाब्रवीद्राजा हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षणः |
संभाराः संभ्रियंतां मे गुरूणां वचनादिह
verses.iast:
tataḥ tuṣṭo'bhavat rājā śrutvā tad dvija bhāṣitam
amātyān abravīt rājā harśha paryākula locana |
sambhārāḥ sambhriyantām me gurūṇām vacanāt iha
verses.translation: " Then King Dasharatha is gladdened on hearing the sayings of those Brahmans. And with happiness lurching on his eyes the king spoke to the ministers, "As advised by my Vedic teachers let the paraphernalia be procured...

verses.devanagari:
समर्थाधिष्ठितश्चाश्वः सोपाध्यायो विमुच्यताम् |
सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम्
verses.iast:
samartha adhiṣṭhitaḥ ca aśvaḥ saḥ upādhyāyo vimucyatām |
sarayvāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhUmir vidhīyatām
verses.translation: "On the northern banks of River Sarayu the ritual ground be arranged... and the Ritual-Horse be released monitored by capable warriors, along with the religious teachers..." So said the king.

glosses.meaning: of River Sarayu, on northern banks

verses.devanagari:
शान्तयश्चापि वर्धन्तां यथाकल्पं यथाविधि |
शक्यः प्राप्तुमयं यज्ञः सर्वेणापि महीक्षिता |
नापराधो भवेत् कष्टो यद्यस्मिन् क्रतुसत्तमे
verses.iast:
śāntayaḥ ca api vardhantām yathā kalpam yathā vidhi |
śakyaḥ prāptum ayam yajñaḥ sarveṇa api mahīkśitā |
na aparādho bhavet kaṣṭo yadi asmin kratu sattame | 1-8-16 |
verses.translation: "Let peace invocations be prevailing and prospering, as ordained in the scriptures and tradition...if it is possible for the correct performance to obtain results of this ritual, and if it is possible to conduct this ritual without any difficult faults during its performance, then all the kings on earth would have performed it...

glosses.meaning: by all, even, kings, on earth
possible, to obtain [to perform and obtain results.]

verses.devanagari:
छिद्रं हि मृगयन्तेऽत्र विद्वांसो ब्रह्मराक्षसाः |
विधिहीनस्य यज्ञस्य सद्यः कर्ता विनश्यति
verses.iast:
chidram hi mṛgayante sma vidvāṃso brahma rākśasāḥ |
vidhi hīnasya yajñasya sadyaḥ kartā vinaśyati
verses.translation: "Scholarly Brahma-demons will be hunting for the faults alone in the course of this ritual... should the procedure of this ritual be depraved of its set rules, the performer gets ruined...

verses.devanagari:
तद्यथा विधिपूर्वं मे क्रतुरेष समाप्यते |
तथा विधानं क्रियतां समर्थाः साधनेष्विति
verses.iast:
tadyathā vidhi pūrvam me kratureṣa samāpyate |
tathā vidhānam kriyatām samarthāḥ sādhaneṣu iti
verses.translation: "Therefore, you all shall see as to how this ritual of mine be conducted and concluded procedurally, and all of you are evidently experts in conducting such rituals... isn't it!
notes: Vedic Brahmans are to be very cautious and vigilant while performing the ritual in the order of ritual acts, faultless rendering of the Vedic hymns and other observant items of the Vedic canon. Should they by overconfidence or by negligence commit any mistake or fault, they take rebirth as Brahma-demons. After taking rebirth as such demons they, with their inherent jealousy and ire will always be hunting for such mistakes in other's ritual performances. If they cannot find one, they cause certain hindrances in that performance, so that the performer may commit mistakes and get ruined in the present life span and then take rebirth as Brahma-demon. Hence, every Vedic-ritual performer shall be vigilant.

glosses.meaning: as to how, it will be concluded
in that way, it shall be done
thus [the king said to his teachers.]

verses.devanagari:
तथेति चाब्रुवन्सर्वे मंत्रिणः प्रतिपूजिता |
पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तद्वाक्यं यथापूर्वं निशम्य ते
verses.iast:
tathā iti ca abruvan sarve mantriṇaḥ pratipūjitā |
pārthivendrasya tad vākyam yathā pūrvam niśaṃya te
verses.translation: On listening the words of the king all the ministers adored and assured him saying, 'It will be conducted faultlessly as has been conducted earlier...'

glosses.meaning: king's, the best one's, that, word
as, earlier [ as has been conducted]
that way [this will also be conducted]

verses.devanagari:
तथा द्विजास्ते धर्मज्ञा वर्धयन्तो नृपोत्तमम् |
अनुज्ञातास्ततः सर्वे पुनर्जग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.iast:
tathā dvijāḥ te dharmajñā varthayato nṛpottamam |
anujñātāḥ tataḥ sarve punar jagmur yathā āgatam
verses.translation: On hearing those words of that best king, and what that is spoken earlier, then the virtue knowing Brahman scholars hailing that best king took leave of him and wentaway as they have come.

glosses.meaning: enhancing [his royal stature,] of that king

verses.devanagari:
विसर्जयित्वा तान्विप्रान् सचिवानिदमब्रवीत् |
ऋत्विग्भिरुपसंदिष्टो यथावत् क्रतुराप्यताम्
verses.iast:
visarjayitvā tān viprān sacivān idam abravīt |
ṛtvigbhiḥ upasandiṣṭo yathāvat kratur āpyatām
verses.translation: Then on sending off those Brahman scholars, the king spoke this way to the ministers... "As advised by the Vedic scholars this ritual shall be conducted, procedurally..."

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वा नृपशार्दूलः सचिवान्समुपस्थितान् |
विसर्जयित्वा स्वं वेश्म प्रविवेश महामतिः
verses.iast:
iti uktvā nṛpa śārdUlaḥ sacivān samupasthitān |
visarjayitvā svam veśma praviveśa mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: Tha tigerly-king and highly intellectual Dasharatha, on saying thus to his ministers who are still in his audience, sent away those ministers also, and he entered his palace.

verses.devanagari:
ततः स गत्वा ताः पत्नीर्नरेन्द्रो हृदयंगमाः |
उवाच दीक्षां विशत यक्ष्येऽहं सुतकारणात्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa gatvā tāḥ patnīr narendro hṛdayaṅgamāḥ |
uvāca dīkśām viśata yaxe'ham suta kāraṇāt
verses.translation: And on approaching his wives, that best king's heartily dear ones, he said to them, " I am performing a Vedic ritual for the reason of begetting sons, and you all shall enter a vow..."

verses.devanagari:
तासां तेनातिकान्तेन वचनेन सुवर्चसाम् |
मुखपद्मान्यशोभन्त पद्मानीव हिमात्यये
verses.iast:
tāsām tena ati kāntena vacanena suvarcasām |
mukha padmān aśobhanta padmānīva himātyaye
verses.translation: On hearing those words of the king, the lustrous countenances of the queens have become more gleaming, like the blooming lotuses after the clearance of dew-fall. [1-8-24b, c]
